title: 第4章 林知渔，卒
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“老婆，算我求你了，就一百万，这次我肯定会赚翻的！”

面容狰狞的男人似精分一样又跪在地上，哭得涕泗横流地乞求着面前狼狈的女人。

“李志龙，收手吧，你已经赔进去六百万了，”女人跪倒在角落，悲痛欲绝，“你就算，就算不为我着想，也得为星星的前途考虑啊，我……”

“闭嘴！一个丫头能花多少钱！”李志龙突然爆起，“天天学这学那的，几千几万的砸进去，不如交给我投资，”他哑着声音说，一副死皮赖脸的样子，“晴雨，我保证，不出三个月，我一定，一定能给你最低两百万！

“再说了，你那不是还有五百多万吗，就给我一点没损失的。”

“你想都别想。这是我爸给我的钱，我不可能给你挥霍的。”

“李晴雨！”

砰的一声巨响，像是什么被狠狠摔在了地上。

站在玄关处的林知渔被吓了一跳，她骤然攥紧了门把手，而后听到了里面男人的气急败坏的声音——

“老子是不是给你脸了！”

接着，是女人痛苦的呜咽声。

这个声音听得林知渔心里一阵发堵。

算了，再拼一次，总会是要死了才能回去。

念及此，林知渔开始到处在客厅里搜找趁手的武器，正当她想到去厨房拿刀的时候，原本虚掩的卧室门冷不丁地被拉开，正正好对上了站在门内男人猩红的眼睛。

李志龙眼色暗了几分，“你是谁？为什么会出现在我家？”

他一边说着，一边往林知渔的方向走。

林知渔心跳如擂鼓，不知道哪里来的勇气，她一咬牙，不管不顾地往厨房跑去。

“贱人！”李志龙阴沉着脸低声咒骂着，他抄起客厅展柜上的一个比较大的奖杯，不紧不慢地朝厨房走去。

林知渔双手拿着刀对着门口站着的男人。

“你别过来，我已经报警了！”

“是么？”李志龙脸上带着一丝玩味，“我怎么不信呢……不过就算你报警了又能怎么样，我们这顶多算是夫妻之间的矛盾，而你……私闯民宅，一个小偷会报警吗？”

小偷……

听到这个词，林知渔下意识为自己找借口：“我不是小偷，我是你老婆请的家教。”

“呵，”李志龙脸上的笑瞬间消失，双眼阴鸷地盯着林知渔，一步一步上前，“说，她给了你多少钱？”

林知渔双手微微颤着，这一刻，看着凶神恶煞的男人，她感受到了前所未有的害怕。

下一秒，林知渔瞳孔骤缩。

Page (1/3)

"Honey, let me beg you, it's only one million. I will definitely make a lot of money this time!"

The man with a ferocious face was kneeling on the ground again, crying and begging for the embarrassed woman in front of him.

"Li Zhilong, stop it, you have already lost six million," the woman knelt down in the corner, heartbroken, "Even if you don't think about me, you still have to think about Xingxing's future, I..."

"Shut up! How much money can a girl spend!" Li Zhilong burst out suddenly, "I study this and that every day, and spend thousands and tens of millions on it, why not let me invest," he said in a hoarse voice, looking shameless, "Qingyu, I promise, within three months, I will definitely give you at least two million!

"Besides, don't you still have more than five million? Just give me nothing you have lost."

“Don’t even think about it.This is the money my dad gave me, and I can't possibly squander it on you."

"Li Qingyu!"

There was a loud bang, like something was thrown to the ground.

Lin Zhiyu, who was standing at the entrance, was startled. She suddenly tightened her grip on the door handle, and then heard the furious voice of the man inside——

"Did I give you face?"

Then came the woman's painful whimpering.

This voice made Lin Zhiyu feel congested.

Forget it, if you try again, you will always have to die before you can go back.

Thinking of this, Lin Zhiyu began to search around the living room for weapons. Just when she thought of going to the kitchen to get a knife, the bedroom door that was originally ajar was suddenly opened, and she met the scarlet eyes of the man standing inside the door.

Li Zhilong's eyes darkened a bit, "Who are you?Why are you at my house?"

As he spoke, he walked in the direction of Lin Zhiyu.

Lin Zhiyu's heart was beating like a drum. She didn't know where she got the courage. She gritted her teeth and ran to the kitchen regardless.

“Bitch!"Li Zhilong cursed in a low voice with a gloomy face. He picked up a larger trophy on the display cabinet in the living room and walked slowly towards the kitchen.

Lin Zhiyu held a knife in both hands and pointed it at the man standing at the door.

"Don't come over, I've already called the police!"

"Really?Li Zhilong had a hint of amusement on his face, "Why don't I believe it... But so what if you call the police? Ours is at best a conflict between husband and wife, and you... broke into a house privately. Would a thief call the police?""

Thief...

Hearing this word, Lin Zhiyu subconsciously made an excuse for himself: "I am not a thief, I am a tutor hired by your wife."

"Ha," the smile on Li Zhilong's face disappeared in an instant, staring at Lin Zhiyu with evil eyes, and stepped forward step by step, "Tell me, how much did she give you?"

Lin Zhiyu's hands were trembling slightly. At this moment, looking at the fierce man, she felt an unprecedented fear.

The next second, Lin Zhiyu's pupils shrank suddenly.
